g.text: N FLOOR PROTECTIVE RETURN · CONSTRUCTED REFERENCE
Old innerDPC−180..−30 stays behind this shoe/tray; geometric crest15, certified first harm NULL.
Wet shoe−180→15;152.5 cap returns across weather brick/cavity.
Backleg60 at outside glass face; no thermal metal bridge through glass.
Weep15 / enddam75 / fixings150 / no wet-floor holes.
Wrapped jamb-base collars follow actual finished portal;
100 accessible laps,75 end dams, no clear-path upstand.
Outdoor Nfloor may wet; occupants use west bypass.
Actual metal/mineral seals, movement, cavities, retained residues and physical first-wetting remain MAT/RWT/OAS duties.
This new protective assembly changes the reference; it does not turn the historical−30 DPC into a qualified higher datum.
